Text with *emphasis*, _also emphasis_, **strong**, __also strong__,
and ***both***. A snake_case_word stays plain, and so does 2 * 3 * 4.

Inline `code with *stars*` and ``code with a ` backtick``.

A [link](https://example.com), a [titled link](/about/ "About us"),
an ![image](/img/logo.png "Logo"), and a [link with *emphasis*](/x).

Escapes: \*not emphasis\*, \[not a link\], and a literal \\ backslash.
